label: waist
description: Waist circumference measured in centimeters, an anthropometric measurement of abdominal adiposity

label: body_comp_total_fat_mass
description: Total body fat mass across all regions (arms, legs, trunk, android and gynoid regions), measured in kilograms via DXA

label: body_comp_android_tissue_mass
description: Total tissue mass in android region (upper body/abdominal area) measured in kilograms from DXA, including fat and lean tissue

label: body_comp_gynoid_tissue_mass
description: Total tissue mass in the gynoid region (hips and thighs), measured in kilograms, including all tissue types in this area

label: body_comp_total_fat_free_mass
description: Total fat-free mass of the entire body, measured in kilograms, representing total lean tissue mass including muscle and bone

label: Cadence: median - TM3
description: Median cadence measured in steps per minute during treadmill walking at 3 km/h. Cadence is the number of steps taken per unit time and is a fundamental temporal gait parameter.

label: Arm_Swing_1D_in_z_dir_m: median - TM3
description: Median arm swing amplitude in the z-direction (vertical) measured in meters during treadmill walking at 3 km/h. Arm swing is a component of normal gait biomechanics affecting balance and locomotion efficiency.

label: LStep_length_m: median - TM3
description: Median left step length measured in meters during treadmill walking at 3 km/h. Step length is the distance between consecutive foot contacts and is a key spatial gait parameter used to assess walking biomechanics and mobility.

label: Step_width_m: median - TM3
description: Median step width measured in meters during treadmill walking at 3 km/h. Step width is the lateral distance between the feet during walking, an indicator of gait stability and balance.

label: body_legs_area
description: Combined bone area of both legs measured via DXA imaging, representing total projected bone tissue area in both lower limbs

label: body_total_area
description: Total body scan area measured by DXA (Dual-Energy X-ray Absorptiometry), representing the total scanned tissue area in cm²

label: body_legs_bmc
description: Combined bone mineral content of both legs measured via DXA imaging, representing total mineral mass in both lower limb skeletons

label: body_total_bmc
description: Total Body Bone Mineral Content measured by DXA, representing the total mineral content of bones in grams

label: body_arms_bmc
description: Combined bone mineral content of both arms measured by DXA scan, representing total bilateral arm bone mass in grams

label: frailty_body_comp_leg_left_lean_mass
description: Lean muscle mass (fat-free mass excluding bone) in the left leg, typically measured in kilograms using bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA) or DEXA. Used to assess muscular symmetry and overall lower body muscle mass in frailty evaluation.

label: frailty_body_comp_leg_right_lean_mass
description: Lean muscle mass (fat-free mass excluding bone) in the right leg, typically measured in kilograms using bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA) or DEXA. A key body composition marker used to assess muscle loss and sarcopenia, which are core features of the frailty syndrome.

label: hand_grip_left
description: Maximal left hand grip strength measured in kilograms using a hand dynamometer, indicating muscular strength and overall physical function

label: hand_grip_right
description: Maximal right hand grip strength measured in kilograms using a hand dynamometer, indicating muscular strength and overall physical function

label: ahi
description: Apnea-Hypopnea Index; the number of apnea and hypopnea events per hour of sleep, a key diagnostic measure for sleep apnea severity

label: hypoxic_burden
description: Cumulative measure of hypoxemia severity - quantifies the total oxygen desaturation burden during sleep, typically calculated as area under the curve of low oxygen saturation episodes

label: odi
description: Overall Oxygen Desaturation Index - measures the total number of oxygen desaturation events per hour across entire sleep study

label: saturation_mean
description: Mean oxygen saturation level (SpO2) across the entire sleep recording, measured as a percentage. Average oxygenation status during sleep and indicator of overall sleep-related hypoxemia burden.

label: rdi
description: Respiratory Disturbance Index - total number of apneic and hypopneic events per hour of sleep (similar to AHI)

label: L_HDL_CE
description: Large HDL Cholesteryl Ester - cholesteryl ester content in large HDL particles

label: L_HDL_C
description: Large HDL Cholesterol - cholesterol content in large high-density lipoprotein particles (protective 'good' cholesterol subclass)

label: HDL_size
description: HDL particle size; the average diameter or size classification of HDL particles in nanometers

label: VLDL_size
description: Particle size of very-low-density lipoprotein (VLDL) measured in nanometers. VLDL is a lipoprotein produced by the liver that carries triglycerides and cholesterol in the bloodstream. Larger VLDL particles are generally considered less atherogenic than smaller, denser particles.

label: L_VLDL_TG
description: Very Low-Density Lipoprotein triglyceride content - measures the triglyceride concentration within VLDL particles

label: r_mv_I
description: R-wave voltage (in millivolts) measured from electrocardiogram lead I. ECG parameter reflecting left ventricular electrical activity.

label: sitting_blood_pressure_systolic
description: Systolic blood pressure in mmHg measured while patient is in sitting position

label: l_ankle_pressure
description: Left ankle systolic blood pressure measurement in mmHg

label: lying_blood_pressure_systolic
description: Systolic blood pressure in mmHg measured in lying/supine position, indicates pressure in arteries when heart contracts

label: standing_three_min_blood_pressure_systolic
description: Systolic blood pressure in mmHg measured after standing for 3 minutes

label: bt__triglycerides
description: Triglyceride blood concentration; measures fatty acids in blood (mg/dL), a key lipid panel component indicating metabolic health

label: bt__hdl_cholesterol
description: HDL cholesterol blood concentration ('good' cholesterol) in mg/dL; protective factor for cardiovascular health

label: bt__non_hdl_cholesterol
description: Non-HDL cholesterol blood concentration; measures total 'bad' cholesterol (LDL, VLDL, IDL) in mg/dL; indicator of cardiovascular risk

label: bt__total_cholesterol
description: Total cholesterol blood concentration; sum of all cholesterol types (HDL, LDL, VLDL) in mg/dL; key cardiovascular health marker

label: Cholic acid glucuronide.1
description: Annotated metabolite (original: 3.35_583.3120m_z)

label: 12a-Hydroxy-3-oxocholadienic acid_Bufalin
description: Annotated metabolite (original: 3.85_385.2388m_z)

label: liver_sound_speed
description: Measures the speed of sound propagation through liver tissue; a physical property used in ultrasound elastography and tissue characterization to assess liver stiffness and fibrosis.

label: liver_attenuation
description: Measures the attenuation coefficient of ultrasound or imaging waves passing through liver tissue; indicates liver density and composition, useful for detecting fatty liver disease and other structural abnormalities.

label: liver_viscosity
description: Measures the viscosity (thickness/resistance to flow) of liver tissue, typically obtained through ultrasound or imaging techniques to assess liver tissue properties and potential fibrosis or disease state.

label: liver_elasticity
description: Measures the stiffness and elasticity of liver tissue using elastography techniques; a key biomarker for assessing liver fibrosis and disease progression, particularly in hepatitis and cirrhosis.

label: bt__platelets
description: Platelet Count - the number of thrombocytes (platelets) in blood; low platelet counts (thrombocytopenia) are associated with advanced liver disease and portal hypertension due to splenic sequestration.

label: bt__wbc
description: Total white blood cell (WBC) count (typically measured in thousands per microliter, K/µL). Represents total concentration of all leukocytes in circulation.

label: bt__lymphocytes_abs
description: Absolute count of lymphocytes in blood (typically measured in thousands per microliter, K/µL). Represents total number of lymphocytes independent of other WBC types.

label: bt__neutrophils_abs
description: Absolute count of neutrophils in blood (typically measured in thousands per microliter, K/µL). Indicates total neutrophil concentration independent of other WBC populations.

label: bt__monocytes_abs
description: Absolute count of monocytes in blood (typically measured in thousands per microliter, K/µL). Represents total monocyte concentration in circulation.

label: Foods_per_day
description: Count of distinct food items consumed per day, a dietary diversity metric

label: copper_mg
description: Mean daily copper intake in milligrams

label: totaldietaryfiber_g
description: Mean daily dietary fiber intake in grams

label: folate_mcg
description: Mean daily folate (vitamin B9) intake in micrograms

label: magnesium_mg
description: Mean daily magnesium intake in milligrams

label: vigorous_activity_minutes
description: Total minutes per week of vigorous-intensity physical activity, a cardiovascular fitness and lifestyle measure

label: work_hours_per_day
description: Average daily hours spent working, measuring occupational time commitment on a daily basis

label: hours_watching_tv
description: Hours spent watching television per week, measuring sedentary screen-based leisure time

label: moderate_activity_days
description: Number of days per week on which the participant engages in moderate-intensity physical activity

label: walking_days_per_week
description: Number of days per week on which the participant engages in at least 10 minutes of walking activity

label: bt__mchc
description: Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin Concentration - measures the average concentration of hemoglobin within red blood cells (g/dL). Calculated from hemoglobin divided by hematocrit.

label: bt__rbc
description: Red Blood Cell Count - measures the number of red blood cells per microliter of blood (typically in millions/μL). Assesses oxygen-carrying capacity and diagnoses anemia or erythrocytosis.

label: bt__hct
description: Hematocrit - measures the percentage of blood volume occupied by red blood cells (%). Indicates the proportion of blood composed of RBCs.

label: bt__hemoglobin
description: Hemoglobin concentration in blood (typically measured in g/dL) - measures the oxygen-carrying protein in red blood cells. Essential for diagnosing anemia and assessing overall blood health.

label: bt__mcv
description: Mean Corpuscular Volume - measures the average size of red blood cells in femtoliters (fL). Used to classify types of anemia and assess red blood cell morphology.

label: health_satisfaction
description: Subjective rating of satisfaction with overall health status and health condition

label: little_interest_or_pleasure_fortnight
description: Assessment of anhedonia (loss of interest or pleasure) over a two-week period, a cardinal symptom of Major Depressive Disorder

label: iglu_sdw
description: Standard deviation within days - glucose variability during daytime periods

label: iglu_iqr
description: Interquartile Range (IQR) of glucose values - measure of glucose variability representing the spread of the middle 50% of glucose readings

label: bt__glucose
description: Blood glucose concentration measured at a specific time point, typically in mg/dL or mmol/L, used to assess current glycemic status and screen for diabetes or hyperglycemia
